name: NZ Road Centrelines (Topo, 1:50,000)
description: The national topographic road-line layer maintained for Topo50 mapping.
story: Roads that once appeared chiefly as symbols on compiled topographic sheets are maintained as line features in LINZ's Topo50 database. The layer records formed all-weather routes at the mapping scale and supports cartography and GIS applications.

Topographic road centrelines have a different purpose and lineage from road-addressing data and legal road parcels. Those three datasets should not be merged merely because their lines often occupy the same part of a map.
